title: Malaysian and 2 local drug suspects killed in a buy-bust gunfight in Tubig Mampallam, Bongao
summary: A Malaysian national, Janimal Bin Hajad, alias "Ungod", and 2 local accomplices, Sansibar Amil Amirul and Alma Sarikin Amirul, were killed when they pulled guns on agents of the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency, police and Navy Marines during a buy-bust at a beachside in Barangay Tubig Mampallam, Bongao, Tawi-Tawi, at about 4:50 p.m. on Sunday, 15 November 2026, according to George Paul Alcovindas, PDEA-BARMM director. A 4th suspect, Nurhaipa Ansari Hajim, surrendered. About 2 kilograms of suspected shabu, worth P13.4 million to P13.6 million, a pistol and a motorized wooden boat were seized; no government personnel were hurt. The first reports, from PDEA's Tawi-Tawi office, gave 2 dead, the Malaysian and 1 Filipino, and said 2 unnamed women were wounded by stray bullets; the later account of 3 dead is used here.

title: Barangay chair, her son and a social-services worker wounded in an ambush on their pickup in Tumbras, Kadayangan
summary: Gunmen in a white vehicle cut off and fired on a black Ford Ranger pickup carrying Fatima Mokamad, chair of Barangay Tumbras, Kadayangan, in the Special Geographic Area, her son and an employee of the Ministry of Social Services and Development, at about 2 p.m. on Monday, 16 November 2026, as the 3 drove out of the village's interior toward the national highway, according to Lt. Julito Gonzales, Kadayangan police chief. All 3 were wounded and taken to hospital; the gunmen fled, and police locked down the roads around the village. The motive was not known.

sources.title: Barangay chief, 2 others hurt in BARMM ambush

title: Retired soldier shot dead at the wheel on the national highway in Kurintem, Datu Odin Sinsuat
summary: Danny Alif Lakim, 68, a retired Army soldier from Poblacion Salbu, Datu Saudi-Ampatuan, was shot several times by gunmen on a motorcycle as he drove his Toyota Avanza toward Cotabato City on the national highway in Sitio Gubat, Barangay Kurintem, Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte, at about 3:45 p.m. on Monday, 16 November 2026, according to Lt. Col. Brian Balite, the town's police chief. The vehicle ran into a shallow ravine and hit a coconut tree, and Lakim died at the scene. A video of the attack spread on social media. The motive was not known.

title: Gunman fires on 3 people in a car in Rosary Heights, Cotabato City; 2 suspects caught, 1 of them wounded
summary: 2 men on a motorcycle followed a blue Suzuki Palette carrying a man and 2 women home from the BGC Compound and fired on it with a .45-calibre pistol in Mother Barangay Rosary Heights, Cotabato City, at about 6:45 p.m. on Monday, 16 November 2026, according to PNP-BARMM spokesperson Capt. Steffi Salanguit. The 3 escaped unhurt and called the police. Police Station 2 caught both suspects, men from Datu Saudi-Ampatuan, in a hot pursuit in which one of them was wounded.

sources.title: Tatlo katao pinagbabaril sa Cotabato City; Dalawang suspek agad nahuli

title: House fire in Mother Tamontaka, Cotabato City; 1 hurt by an exploding LPG tank
summary: A house caught fire in Mother Barangay Tamontaka, Cotabato City, at about noon on Tuesday, 17 November 2026. The Cotabato City fire station and residents put it out quickly. Bystanders said 1 person was hurt when an LPG tank exploded and was taken to hospital. The station's first report did not give the cause or the person's name.

sources.title: LOOK: Isang bahay sa Mother Tamontaka, Cotabato City, nasunog ngayong tanghali.
